methods.gate: Gate at the prior close for the arrival of each marked return. Gate subsets use trading-session annualization.
methods.gross: Same fills and quantities. Restore their charged fees and adverse execution slippage in that day's return.
methods.invested_sessions: Whole-account net close-to-close returns on sessions with stock exposure at the preceding close or during the session, including opening purchases and final sales. Benchmark uses the same pairs of dated closes. No rescaling to full exposure.
methods.planned_entries: Each opening purchase or top-up sized above zero, or a planned new name unable to buy a whole share, counted once. A missing opening quote uses the preceding holding mark to classify a retained underweight position. Only missing executable data enters the coverage numerator. Out-of-window pending instructions are disclosed separately.
methods.turnover: One half of absolute traded opening notional divided by preceding marked equity.
methods.verdict: An unresolved valuation makes the overall verdict inconclusive. Compare matching covered windows only. Coverage requires a complete valuation path and at most 10% of due purchases blocked by missing data. Require at least two thirds of included windows to beat TRI, higher linked CAGR, and drawdown no larger than 1.2 times TRI.
